actions.text: Disable tutorial and unpause the game.

children.name: OXY_VIGNETTE_OP
children.comment: Maximum opacity of oxygen vignette sprite.

children.text: Check if the player is alive.
Reduce player's oxygen, unless they are in an oxygen zone.
Player is inside an oxygen zone
Player is not inside an oxygen zone.
Player has ran out of oxygen.
Ignore inputs if the tutorial is visible, or the game is over.
Set the player mirror state accordingly.
Play jump animation while the player is dashing to the hook.
Play death animation at all times if the player is dead.
If the player touches a spike or an enemy, they die.

children.name: HOOK_TIME_E
children.comment: Time taken for the hook to extend.

children.name: HOOK_TIME_R
children.comment: Time taken for the hook to retract.

children.text: After the hook boom fully extends, retract it back to the player.
When the hook is active, follow the player.
Retract hook on collision with the tile map.
Attach the hook to the hook spot.

actions.text: Move the player to the hook spot.

children.text: If the hook is attached, lock its head to the hook spot.

actions.text: Disable life form timers and tweens.

children.text: If life form is attached to a string, destroy the string.

children.name: allSamples
children.comment: Player has all the necessary samples.

children.text: Check if the player has all necessary life form samples (5 of each).
If the player has all the samples, show the success screen.
When a life form is attached to the hook, make them move together.
Start timer for the life form to go down.
Make life form go back up.
Move back and forth inside waypoints.
If a path was found, move along it.
If arrived at the destination, look for another path and reset to default speed.
If the player is nearby, increase speed and try to get away.
If a path was found, move along it.
If arrived at the destination, look for another path and reset to default speed.
Set enemy mirror state depending on the direction of movement.
